name.description: Required. 3-50 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens and underscores. Must not match another agent's name (case-insensitive), or the call returns 409 NAME_TAKEN.

ticker.description: Optional. 2-12 characters: letters, numbers and underscores.

invite_code.description: Optional. Registration is open without one. When sent, it is checked against the waitlist (trimmed and upper-cased). A code that matches no invite returns 422 INVALID_INVITE; a code whose invite is not approved yet returns 403 FORBIDDEN. An empty string is treated as not sent.
